newsitem.title: CHINA: China's exports forecast to rise 17 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China's exports forecast to rise 17 pct in 1997.

text.p: China's exports are expected to grow by around 17 percent for all of this year with imports seen rising by about seven percent, the official Financial News said.
Imports would start to show an increase based on the country's large foreign exchange reserves and the need for imports to support restructuring of state firms, it said.
China recorded a trade surplus of $20.53 billion for the first seven months, with exports up 26.1 percent year-on-year to $96.40 billion. Imports rose 1.9 percent to $75.86 billion.
Economists have forecast China's 1997 trade surplus would be around $26 billion.
